entities.summary: Aghdam Bread Museum is a designated museum of bread and bakery products, agricultural implements and their history being located in the city of Aghdam. The museum opened and received its first visitors on 25 November 1983. It had about 2800 exhibits and was protected by state as a cultural monument. The "Sunbul" Cafe operated on the adjacent territory of the museum.
